name: EASTERN DIAMONDBACK RATTLESNAKE
desc: EASTERN DIAMONDBACK RATTLESNAKE (Crotalus adamanteus): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The eastern diamondback rattlesnake is a species of pit viper in the family Viperidae. The species is endemic to the Southeastern United States.
